title: console list view: `sharing.lockedBy` is never shown and the Share button has no handler
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

A shared, locked list view shows no lock owner, and clicking Share does nothing.

## Reproduction

1. List view with `sharing: {lockedBy: <user>}` → no lock indicator.
2. Click Share → no dialog, no request.

## Expected

Lock owner shown; Share opens the sharing control (or the button is not rendered).

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`plugin-list` ListView.tsx ~5970-5980; the test at ListView.test.tsx ~2572 is misnamed and does not cover it.

## Filing facts

- reach: Console UI, measured twice by the view gap-fill card.
- Business reason: A visible button that does nothing.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:records`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `list view sharing lockedBy Share button no handler` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 0 hits.
- QA id: R2
